stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks you to turn the phone to landscape when it needs it, and an unlocked screen would rotate on its own as you steer.
stumbles.why: Locking in portrait while the game wants landscape is confusing, and it doesn't say how turning the phone to landscape works with the lock on.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone the way you want to drive. Steering is calibrated when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: Start lights are never mentioned earlier, and the text doesn't say when or how the race starts after 'Start engine'. It also doesn't say whether tilt should be level or at some angle.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: Hard to picture in landscape, because the top of the phone is ambiguous when it's sideways. It's also unclear whether tilts are measured from the calibrated position.

point: To play Tilt Rally, lock rotation, open the page on a motion-sensor phone, pick a track, start the engine, go landscape, and steer by tilting left or right, with forward tilt to accelerate and back tilt to brake, measured from your pose when the lights go out.
